summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private instrument of protocol and justification for the merger of its wholly-owned subsidiary Juno Participações e Investimentos S.A. into itself. The merger is an internal corporate reorganization to simplify the corporate and administrative structure; no consideration is being paid, and no minority shareholders are affected as Juno is wholly owned. The merger will result in Juno being extinguished and AXIA Energia succeeding it by universal title, making TIJO a wholly-owned subsidiary. No board recommendation, advisor, or financial terms are mentioned; the transaction is governed by Brazilian Corporations Law. Since this is an internal restructuring with no external acquirer or premium, it does not fit standard special-situation categories.
